title: Layout / Tips and techniques

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Balance repetition, variation and space so a reader can follow content without monotony or overload.
strategic_value: A shared grid with deliberate changes in rhythm and hierarchy can give IBM communications both continuity and a distinctive sense of movement.
demonstration: The long webpage combines interface and editorial examples with grid overlays and do/don’t comparisons for whitespace, hierarchy, compositional flow and asymmetry.
practical_value: Plan repeated content units, pauses and focal points before refining a composition’s alignment and asymmetric balance.

content_islands.name: Pattern and structural rhythm
content_islands.spec: Open with paired communication examples, then a laptop grid overlay and sizing-scale demonstration.

content_islands.name: Editorial rhythm
content_islands.spec: Place tall webpage sequences together to compare repeated and alternating content units.

content_islands.name: Whitespace
content_islands.spec: Follow the breathing-room rationale with a spacious-versus-crowded wireframe pair and a full webpage example.

content_islands.name: Hierarchy and flow
content_islands.spec: Compare typographic hierarchy, then show a structured service webpage and a dark threat-intelligence dashboard before editorial compositions illustrating eye movement.

content_islands.name: Asymmetry
content_islands.spec: End with balanced-versus-centered wireframes and a group of web, poster and publication examples that distribute positive and negative space unevenly.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains rhythm through music, whitespace as a visual pause and hierarchy as a means of making information navigable.
reference_purposes.Expression: IBM applications show grid-based structure combined with variation, strong type scale and asymmetric space.
reference_purposes.Application: The guidance teaches structural and editorial rhythm, deliberate whitespace, typographic hierarchy and planned eye movement.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The do/don’t pairs reject overcrowding and undifferentiated hierarchy; the text advises avoiding perfect symmetry as less engaging, rather than declaring every symmetric layout forbidden.

ingredient.name: Structural and editorial rhythm
ingredient.role: Give readers continuity and moments of distinction.
ingredient.application: Repeat useful measurements and content structures, then introduce deliberate variation; use whitespace and typographic contrast to show order.
ingredient.scope: IBM layout guidance across pages and media. Rhythm is a composition principle, not a fixed ratio or universal module count.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
